title: Only the author edits a note, deleting needs authorship or Delete
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (the standard Admin role). This is User A.
  2. A work order at this location: top menu Work Orders -> Create Work Order, select a customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair"), save.
  3. A part sale at this location: top menu Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, pick the Customer and click Save.
  4. The customer's own notes: top menu Customers -> open the customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") -> Notes tab.
  5. To write a note on any of these records: on its Notes tab click New Note, type the message, type @ and pick the person from the list, then click Save.
  6. As User A, write one note on each: the work order, the part sale and the customer.
  7. A teammate at the same location to tag, User B, who can sign in: on a QA branch the second user is the Tech quick-login user (sign in from a private browser window with the Tech button; appears as "Tech ShopView"). They are listed under Settings -> Staff. Create the test role: Settings (click your initials at the top right -> Settings) -> Roles & Permissions -> Create Custom Role -> in Choose a template pick "Service Advisor" -> Apply; tick Work orders -> Delete, and untick Part sales -> Delete and Customers -> Delete; enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST WO delete" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> on User B's row click the edit icon -> in Edit Staff Member set Role to "ZZAUTOTEST WO delete" -> Save & Close. User B must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session).
  8. A second teammate, User C. On a QA branch only two users can sign in (Admin and Tech): when a step says "Sign in as User C", first give Tech ShopView User C's role (Settings -> Staff -> on Tech ShopView's row click the edit icon -> Role -> Save & Close; Tech signs out and back in) and run that step as Tech ShopView. For tagging or group membership only, any staff member (e.g. "Ashlee Thomas") can be User C. Create the test role: Settings (click your initials at the top right -> Settings) -> Roles & Permissions -> Create Custom Role -> in Choose a template pick "Service Advisor" -> Apply; tick Part sales -> Delete and Customers -> Delete, and untick Work orders -> Delete; enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST PS and customer delete" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> on User C's row click the edit icon -> in Edit Staff Member set Role to "ZZAUTOTEST PS and customer delete" -> Save & Close. User C must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session).
  9. A teammate with neither role and none of those Delete permissions, User D: on a QA branch, Tech ShopView with its standard Technician role (set its Role back to "Technician" before that step; check under Settings -> Roles & Permissions that the Technician role has no Delete under Work orders, Part sales or Customers).
  10. For the last step: a work order note written by the customer in the Customer Portal, and a system note (one the app wrote itself). If the work order has neither, mark step 5 Blocked and write why.
custom_steps:
1. As User A (the author), edit your work order note and add then remove an attachment.
  2. Sign in as User D and look at User A's notes for edit and delete.
  3. Sign in as User B and look for delete on the work order note, the part sale note and the customer note.
  4. Sign in as User C and look for delete on the same three notes.
  5. As User A, open the customer's portal note and the system note and look for their ⋮ menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Only the author can edit a note or add and remove its attachments; User D is offered neither edit nor delete.
  • User B (Work Orders -> Delete) is offered delete on the work order note only, not on the part sale or customer note.
  • User C (Part Sales -> Delete, Customers -> Delete) is offered delete on the part sale note and the customer note, not on the work order note.
  • A note written by a customer in the portal, and a system note, have no ⋮ menu and cannot be deleted from the app, even by an admin.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10253 (S10, Who can do what); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297) as edited 2 October 2026, S10; read 5 Oct 2026. Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R5: “Only the note's author can edit a note or add and remove its attachments.”
  • S10-R5a: “A note written by staff can be deleted by its author, or by a user who holds Delete for the kind of record it is on: 'Work Orders → Delete' for a work order or work order line note, 'Part Sales → Delete' for a part sale note, and 'Customers → Delete' for a customer or asset note.”
  • S10-R5a: “Notes written by customers in the portal and system notes have no menu and cannot be deleted from the app.”
  • S10-N1: “A user who is not a note's author is not offered edit on it (S10-R5). A user who is not the author and does not hold Delete for that kind of record is not offered delete (S10-R5a).”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
